description: Defines the AppDatabase class for a Room database in an Android app, including database creation, singleton access, and initial data seeding with sample recipes and categories.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Abstract class representing the Room database, including DAOs for recipes and categories, singleton instantiation, and a callback for seeding initial data.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a thread-safe singleton instance of AppDatabase, creating the database if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: seedCallback
methods.description: Returns a RoomDatabase.Callback that seeds initial category and recipe data upon database creation.
